settings.title: Atmosphere
settings.description: One state of Ground, Force and Variations for the whole workspace. Each state retunes reading measure, spacing, interface density, surface warmth, the force line and motion while keeping structure and colour roles.

settings.title: Interaction colour
settings.description: Links, focus and selected controls.

settings.title: Knowledge colour
settings.description: Highlights, references and marked knowledge.

settings.title: Attention colour
settings.description: Critical states and editorial counterforce.

settings.title: Completion colour
settings.description: Completed work and positive semantic states.

settings.title: Reading surface
settings.description: The document plane behind prose.

settings.title: Workspace ground
settings.description: Sidebars, ribbon and the surrounding workspace.

settings.title: Code surface
settings.description: The background of inline and fenced code.

settings.title: Structural line
settings.description: Fine rules separating related surfaces.

settings.title: Reading font
settings.description: Default: EB Garamond. Enter a CSS font-family stack.

settings.title: Heading font
settings.description: Default: Cormorant Garamond. Applies to titles and headings.

settings.title: Interface font
settings.description: Default: Beiruti. Applies to navigation and controls.

settings.title: Code font
settings.description: Default: IBM Plex Mono, with local monospace fallbacks.
settings.default: "IBM Plex Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

settings.title: Reading line height

settings.title: Reading measure
settings.description: Maximum prose width. Per-note widths remain available.

settings.title: Document gutter
settings.description: Horizontal breathing space around the document.

settings.title: Document vertical space
settings.description: Space above and below the editing surface.

settings.title: List indentation
settings.description: Nested list indentation.

settings.title: Control corner radius
settings.description: Small, precise corners across the interface.

settings.title: Structural line width
settings.description: Width of structural surface borders.

settings.title: Scrollbar width
settings.description: Width of desktop scrollbars.

settings.title: Workspace density
settings.description: Adjust the rhythm of navigation and property rows.

settings.title: Overlay material
settings.description: Transient menus can use a restrained translucent surface. Accessibility preferences retain solid surfaces.

settings.title: Document ground
settings.description: Choose a subtle writing texture with a stable solid fallback.

settings.title: Pane dividing lines
settings.description: Add fine boundaries between workspace panes.

settings.title: File tree guides
settings.description: Reveal hierarchy guides beneath file folders.

settings.title: List guides
settings.description: Reveal indentation guides in nested prose lists.

settings.title: Focused writing
settings.description: Emphasise the active editor line while preserving legibility of surrounding text.

settings.title: Active line surface
settings.description: Give the current editor line a quiet raised surface.

settings.title: Callout treatment
settings.description: Use a fine top rule, outlined boundary, tinted field or open annotation.

settings.title: Highlight treatment
settings.description: Choose how marked text carries the knowledge colour.

settings.title: Tag treatment
settings.description: Semantic tags recognise urgent, blocked, done, reference, idea and related English terms.

settings.title: Folder signals
settings.description: Add a measured signal to folder depth or recognised workflow names.

settings.title: Link underline
settings.description: The interaction colour remains visible for every link treatment.

settings.title: Unresolved links
settings.description: Indicate links whose destination is still to be created.

settings.title: Section dividers
settings.description: Divide prose with the theme’s structural line language.

settings.title: List marker shape
settings.description: Keep native list layout while varying the drawn marker.

settings.title: Native task appearance
settings.description: Use the application’s standard checkbox treatment.

settings.title: Wrap code blocks
settings.description: Wrap long code lines within their container.

settings.title: Full-width tables
settings.description: Allow tables to use the available document width.

settings.title: Table row bands
settings.description: Add a quiet alternating surface to table rows.

settings.title: Table cell grid
settings.description: Add fine borders around all table cells.

settings.title: Scrollable diagrams
settings.description: Keep wide Mermaid diagrams and equations in a horizontally scrollable region.

settings.title: Compact properties
settings.description: Reduce vertical space in the property ledger.

settings.title: Image corner radius
settings.description: Corner radius for note images.

settings.title: Maximum image width
settings.description: Maximum width of ordinary images.

settings.title: Banner image height
settings.description: Height for images with the cyriform-banner layout token.

settings.title: Embed maximum height
settings.description: Scrollable maximum height for embedded notes.

settings.title: Image depth
settings.description: Add a restrained offset shadow beneath note images.

settings.title: Open embeds
settings.description: Use an open ruled treatment for embedded notes.

settings.title: Motion
settings.description: A brief settling motion accompanies transient layers. System reduced-motion preferences always apply.

settings.title: Settling duration
settings.description: Duration of the transient-layer settling motion.

settings.title: Mobile control size
settings.description: Minimum target height for mobile controls.

settings.title: Compact mobile reading
settings.description: Reduce page gutters while keeping the touch target size.

settings.title: Show mobile ribbon
settings.description: Keep the native mobile ribbon available within its application layout.

settings.title: Keep dark colours in exports
settings.description: Retain the selected theme palette when the export tool prints backgrounds.

settings.title: Print reading font
settings.description: Choose the reading family for printed pages.

settings.title: Print paragraph alignment
settings.description: Choose paragraph alignment for print. Justified text uses automatic hyphenation.

settings.title: Print text size
settings.description: Body size for printed pages.

settings.title: Print link destinations
settings.description: Append external URL destinations in printed output.
